title.en: Order the B500S-83D for a 5 m, 380 V, 280 kg Sheet
title.zh: 按 5 米、380 V、280 kg 的表订 B500S-83D

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints B500S-83D at 7.5 kW, 380 V, 5 m height, 5 m horizontal, 280 kg and sand or small stone 5–16 mm. The short boom is part of this unit.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 B500S-83D 印成 7.5 kW、380 V、高度 5 m、水平 5 m、280 kg，材料为砂或 5–16 mm 小石。短臂架属于本机。

h1.en: The B500S-83D Order Is the 5 m Sheet
h1.zh: B500S-83D 的订单就是这张 5 米表

directAnswer.en: Order the B500S-83D from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai only when the printed window is the one you mean: 7.5 kW, rated voltage 380 V, delivery height 5 m, horizontal 5 m, frame 915 × 550 × 550 mm, net weight 280 kg, materials sand and small stone 5–16 mm. The type line says manual / electric two-stage structure. The short boom is not a truck-mounted placing boom. There is no m³/h cell and no list price. Send the path to the contact page if those cells match.
directAnswer.zh: 只有印出的窗口就是你要的窗口时，才向河北品锦机械（邢台）订 B500S-83D：7.5 kW、额定电压 380 V、输送高度 5 m、水平 5 m、外形 915 × 550 × 550 mm、净重 280 kg、材料为砂和 5–16 mm 小石。类型行写的是手动/电动两级结构。短臂架不是车载布料杆。没有 m³/h 格子，也没有标价。这些格子相符时，把路径发到询盘页。

heading.en: 380 V is printed on this page

body.en: Do not treat that voltage as the voltage of Electric 15 or Electric 20. Those pages leave voltage blank. B500S-83D is the compact page that prints it.
body.zh: 不要把这个电压当成电动15或电动20的电压。那些页面把电压留空。B500S-83D 是印出电压的紧凑页。

body.en: Height and horizontal distance are each 5 m. This is not Electric 15’s 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal.
body.zh: 高度和水平距离各是 5 m。这不是电动15的垂直 15–20 m 和水平 60–80 m。

body.en: Path, 5–16 mm or your material, and confirmation that 380 V is the site supply. Ask [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) for the price.
body.zh: 路径、5–16 mm 或你的材料，并确认现场供电是 380 V。向 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 询价。

question.en: Is there an output in m³/h?
Is the boom a truck boom?

answer.en: No. It is the short boom on the compact unit.
answer.zh: 不是。它是紧凑机上的短臂架。

alt.zh: B500S-83D 泵，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
